title: I Enforced the Co-op Kitchen Chore Chart on the Founder

parts.text: I washed the third sink of pans at 11:10 p.m. because the founder, Sasha, had hosted a donor dinner and left the chart blank. The chart said cook cleans. I was twenty-two, paying the same rent as Sasha, standing in lemon soap. Sasha said founders don't do dishes, they do vision. I photographed the chart, the pans, and the donor wine glasses with lipstick. At the house meeting Sasha voted to hire a cleaner from our dues. Then she put her compost in my labeled bin because the founder bin was full of unopened mail.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: She wants dues for a cleaner and my compost bin for her mail overflow.

social.video_title: The founder cooked vision and left the pans — Part 1/2
social.description: Lemon soap, donor lipstick, a blank chart. Rent was equal. Would you have spoken at the meeting?

parts.text: I read the chore bylaw out loud. Equal rent, equal chart. The house voted down the cleaner. Sasha did the pans the next donor night with a playlist and a sigh. I took my bin back. The mail found a crate. Vision still happens. It happens after the sink. I sleep better when the drain is empty. The chart has a magnet again. Magnets do not care who incorporated the LLC.

social.video_title: Equal rent read the bylaw out loud — Part 2/2
social.description: No hired guilt, pans on donor night, compost borders restored. Was vision a sponge?
